policy.note: Drupal core maintains the current and previous major release lines. At this snapshot Drupal 10.6.x and 11.4.x were supported; 12.0.x was pre-release and main was development. Drupal 10.x is expected to reach end of life when Drupal 12.0.0 is released. Verify the current schedule before publishing.

targets.scope_note: Stock standard profile. Claro is the admin theme; Default Admin is not present. The generic 'Admin theme' component needs reproduction before a finding is applied to this line.
Default Admin is enabled as the administration theme; the stock 11.4.12 standard profile uses Claro and Olivero. Claro and Olivero are still core themes at this tag.
Pre-release alpha. Claro is the admin theme at this tag; Default Admin is present but not default. Not a supported release.
Pre-release beta. Default Admin is the default and admin theme; Claro and Olivero are no longer core themes. Not a supported release.
Development branch. Findings are not release claims and can change at any commit. Default Admin is the default theme; Claro and Olivero are contributed projects.
